content: {"episode_id":"ep-05001","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was medically necessary for this patient, who presented with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10). The monitoring was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate control management. The documented symptoms and diagnoses support the clinical need for this diagnostic study, and we request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial on the basis of medical necessity."}
